name: get_neighbors
title: Direct neighbors
description: One hop from each target: what calls, references, imports, inherits, or implements it (direction in), and what it calls, references, imports, inherits, or implements (direction out). Each edge gives its resolution level (resolved, import-scoped, or name-match), the file and lines where it occurs, and pending when that file awaits SCIP re-resolution. For more than one hop, use get_impact. Order: target as passed, then in before out, then edge type, then heaviest first, then id.

repo.description: Registered repository name. Optional: defaults to the repository that contains the server's working directory, or the only registered one.

min_resolution.description: The weakest resolution level to include: resolved keeps compiler-resolved edges only; name-match keeps everything.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the other arguments the same.
